values.note: $35 a night; $50 a night over the Fourth of July holiday (June 29 - July 6). First come, first served.

fees.source: https://arnoldsparkcity.com/community/city-parks-and-campground-information/ ('Regular Rates: $35 per night'; 'Fourth of July Holiday Rates: June 29 thru July 6 – $50 per night'; page modified 2026-06-03), read 2026-11-03

note: City of Arnolds Park campground at 7 Bascom St on the north shore of Lake Minnewashta, 3-4 blocks from the amusement park, beside the city's boater's access ramp and dock. The dump station is off site, across from City Park (84 Dewey St) under the water tower. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city page (modified 2026-06-03): $35 ($50 Fourth of July week), 15 electric sites (3 with water), FCFS self-registration, 14 nights in 30 days, showers. City photos show a clear lake view across the boat-ramp lane: waterfront upgrade lead to lakeview. Pin is on a house about 90 m east.
flags: WATERFRONT upgrade lead (not waterfront -> lakeview proposed): the city's own campground photos (2015) show it. IMG_9513 looks down the concrete access lane with RVs and fifth wheels on the grass sites and Lake Minnewashta plainly in view beyond. IMG_9519, from the dock, shows campers parked about 20-30 m back across the ramp lane. NAIP agrees: the site lot is about 25-40 m from the shore, with the public boater's-access lane, ramp and dock (day use), plus a few trees and a shed, between. A view is earned, on-water is not. The stored evidence ('lot ~40 m back from shore behind treed strip with private docks') was read at the stored pin, which sits on a lakeshore house east of the campground.
RATE: $35, and $50 over the Fourth of July week (June 29 - July 6). The page carries no year, but WordPress dates its last edit 2026-06-03, so it is taken as current. Local, so no private price gate.
SEASON: the page states none. The stored inclusion_evidence's 'open year-round' isn't on the page and wasn't written.
FIT OK: city photos show fifth wheels and travel trailers on the sites.

PIN: the stored 43.36432,-95.12790 is on a lakeshore house roof about 90 m east of the site lot, which is centred near 43.36477,-95.12878. That's under the 250 m line, so no correction is required. Google's 'Arnolds Park City Campground' listing sits at 84 Dewey St (the City Park, about 450 m northwest) with 1 review, so it isn't a good pin either.
PHONE OK: 712-332-2341 is the number Google gives, and the city page lists Arnolds Park City Hall (156 N. Hwy 71). Website: the city's own page, fine as stored.

FACILITIES: there is no dump on site (stored dump false). The page sends campers to the station across from City Park, so I left it. No amperage is posted, so no hookups were written. Water is at only 3 of 15 sites, recorded in sites.note.
